final: WITH order_rates AS (SELECT u.acctscope, o.recordvault, AVG(f.feerate) - AVG(f.rebrate) AS net_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users AS u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp GROUP BY u.acctscope, o.recordvault HAVING AVG(f.feerate) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(f.rebrate) IS NOT NULL), scope_rates AS (SELECT acctscope, AVG(net_rate) AS avg_net_rate, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM order_rates GROUP BY acctscope) SELECT acctscope, avg_net_rate, order_count, avg_net_rate - AVG(avg_net_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_plain_average FROM scope_rates
